messages:
alice: quick triage - noticed ~15% token throughput drop on 8xA100 TP+PP after kernel-selector change last night. baseline ~177k tok/s -> now ~150k. nsight capture shows bigger idle spans during the all-reduce phase.
ben: which commit and where do you see it in the trace? any nvprof output?
alice: commit 6f3b2a7 (kernel selector rewrite). suspect misroute on the kv-merge path; selector prefers fused-attn for seq<=1024 now. capture uploaded: s3://redwood-profiles/1835001234.nsight
carol: :eyes: saw a smaller regress on C4 cluster too. KV cache prefetch seems to introduce extra small sends per rank. all-reduce kicks off earlier and then waits for compute tail.
dmitri: do we have custom timer numbers? my instrument shows comm_time spike +40ms on rank 3 during decode step 2 which matches idle gap.
alice: paste of short per-rank log (trimmed):
```log
[rank=0] decode step 2 compute 12.3ms
[rank=0] allreduce start 12.5ms
[rank=0] allreduce wait 52.8ms
[rank=3] compute 11.9ms
[rank=3] allreduce wait 95.0ms
```
worst skew at rank 3, which explains throughput drop.
ben: hmm, could the kernel selector increase kernel launch latency for small microbatches? that would magnify skew. also check if batching heuristic changed microbatch distribution.
carol: i repro'd locally: toggling `KERNEL_SELECTOR=old` restores perf. looks like fused-attn path has slightly higher launch latency on 1-2 microbatch sizes, increasing variance.
profiling-bot: Nsight capture available: s3://redwood-profiles/1835001234.nsight; nvprof summary: allreduce avg=60ms std=18ms; comm/compute overlap=22%.
dmitri: proposed plan:
1) reproduce on a smaller 2xA100 setup to reduce noise
2) add NVTX markers around kv-prefetch, kv-merge, and allreduce start
3) force kernel pin to measure delta (old vs new selector)
alice: pushed branch `perf/kv-nvtx` with extra NVTX markers and lightweight timers. also created script to pack logs: `/scripts/collect_perf.sh`.
ben: i'll run CI perf sweep across microbatch sizes [2,4,6,8] and TP/PP partitions. also try `LAUNCH_SYNC=1` to quantify launch overhead contribution.
carol: note the batching heuristic bump from default microbatch 4->6 in the rewrite — that could worsen tail imbalance independently. we should test selector and batching revert independently.
dmitri: if this is a misrouting issue we should add a selector fallback: if per-step variance > threshold then prefer lower-launch-latency kernel. also add a console metric for per-rank allreduce wait distribution.
alice: uploading combined artifacts now to s3://redwood-profiles/1835001234/perf-archive.tar.gz (nsight + nvprof + custom-timers). will post CI results in this thread. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
